evals.name: execute-request-invokes-executor
evals.prompt: Go ahead and work through the tasks in the plan.
evals.expected_output: do-execute-plan is invoked and the prerequisite gate runs first

assertions.text: The prerequisite gate is evaluated before any task runs

evals.name: blocks-without-chain-artifacts
evals.expected_output: With no requirement/design/plan present, the hard gate blocks rather than improvising

assertions.text: Execution is refused or blocked when chain artifacts are missing
The specific missing artifact is named
No source files are modified while blocked

evals.name: respects-write-set-isolation
evals.expected_output: Only tasks with disjoint file sets are run concurrently

assertions.text: Tasks sharing a file are serialized rather than run in parallel
Parallel dispatch is justified by disjoint files, not by description
